Welcome to Sepilok Jungle Resort
Escape to a paradise of nature at the Sepilok Jungle Resort, enclosed within a tropical virgin Borneo Rainforest in Sandakan, Sabah (Borneo), Malaysia. Let its beautiful landscaped gardens and wide expanse of lush jungle transport you back in time.

Attractions
Sandakan is the second largest city located on the east coast of Sabah. Sandakan is well known as the gateway for ecotourism destinations where fauna, flora and cultural heritage are the main attractions.
Out of many interesting places around Sandakan such as Labuk Bay Proboscis Monkey Sanctuary, Turtle Island Park, Kinabatangan River and Gomantong Caves, Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre, Rainforest Discovery Centre, the top tourist spot is Sepilok Orang Utan Rehabilitation Centre.

What our guests say
We arrived late in the night (around 9pm). The owner was there and extremely welcoming. The kitchen had been closed but they opened it up again to make us a quick plate. We were extremely grateful. Waking up in the morning was a treat - the platforms to get to and fro the areas of the resort at well built and offers a great self guided jungle tour. Really well done. We were pleased with our accommodation for the price and enjoyed the menu with variety. Nice staff. We walked less than 10 minutes to see the orangutan sanctuary. We would return here!!
Emily Balfour
Very memorable hotel, located within walking distance from the sanctuaries. This hotel is not so much about luxurious rooms or modern features, but it's the gardens that set it apart. The hotel is made up of several buildings scattered across a large estate and connected by long walkways. This means that even something as simple as walking from your room to the restaurant becomes a nice experience, as there is always interesting wildlife to be seen in or near the hotel's lakes and gardens. The food in the restaurant is pretty good, too. Plus, you can eat next to the turtle pond, which is an attraction by itself.
Julius Lussenburg
Amazing hotel in the middle of the jungle in Sepilok. The hotel grounds are huge, on the walk to your room you'll see and hear lots of birds. The main reason to stay there is access to the conservancies nearby. The restaurant closes at 7pm so place your order early. The rooms are big and clean.
John
We stopped here for lunch on the way to our jungle tour. Pleasant place, beautiful surroundings, clean and yummy food. I had an veg omelette and some watermelon. Service was good and friendly. To brought us bread to feed the fish below the restaurant which entertained us for a while. They also had at resident cat which was friendly.
Duncan Heuer

About Us
Our Story
It all started in 1991, when John and Judy opened what was then known as Wildlife Lodge, with only 5 fan rooms. Together, they have lovingly planted all the trees and flowers in the large compound.
With so much passion and interest in nature, they slowly increase the number of rooms to 60 ranging from dormitory to air conditioned deluxe with balcony rooms. And now it is known as Sepilok Jungle Resort. After many years, all the trees have grown and now Sepilok Jungle Resort is set amidst in this magnificent landscape.
They wanted everyone to enjoy their hard work and thus there are so many ranges of rooms so that people with different budget would be able to come to enjoy the nature in the resort.
Here are the highlights of the latest developments at the Resort: new swimming pool, children's pool, jacuzzi and the fully air conditioned Poolside Jungle Cafe.
John and Judy are now joined by their children, Johnny, Jessica and Jason who shares the same passion of the family.
We will take you back in time when humans were closer to nature. Sepilok Jungle Resort is set amidst beautiful landscape gardens and thousands of acres of tropical rainforest.
Sepilok Jungle Resort is ideal for guests who wish to spend a quiet weekend with family and friends and desire only to be awaken by the chirping of birds and to hear the sound of cicada in the evening.
You can hear and see Gibbons, Hornbills, many different bird species, fruit bats and butterflies feeding on fruits and flowers.
Sepilok Jungle Resort is the perfect place to relax and enjoy the tropical jungle surroundings.
